snippet.title: Teardown: Relics of Barkuna
snippet.description:
Deep in the jungle of Barkuna lies an untouched ancient civilization, filled with lost relics, ancient puzzles, hidden paths and long-forgotten secrets.

In Teardown: Relics of Barkuna, you play as James Thorvaldsson, a seasoned solo explorer commissioned by the Relic Hunters Group to retrieve the legendary Great Gem of Barkuna.

Explore the jungle-covered Jaguar’s Haven, traverse the cliffs of Eagle’s Perch, and uncover the mysteries hidden within the lava-filled Serpent’s Hollow. Along the way, you’ll solve puzzles, discover new tools, collect treasure, unlock hidden areas, and piece together the secrets of Barkuna.

Relics of Barkuna blends exploration, puzzle-solving, collectible hunting and progression-based discovery in a treasure-filled adventure.


Grab Teardown on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1167630/Teardown/
